rv.q: This is an imaginative piece of programming in an intimate theatre and deserves a larger audience.
These are wonderful pieces of 20th century music theatre and it’s very interesting to see them side by side.
For someone who does not regularly watch opera, this was a genuinely interesting evening and one that has left me wanting to explore the form further.

See it if you can. It is a wonderfully accessible introduction to the power of opera to take us beyond the spoken word, as well as an opportunity to see two rarely performed works together in an intimate theatre in the heart of London.
A unique night nonetheless, and something fresh for a limited 10-show run at the Theatre until the 19th September.

cn.t: This operatic double bill earns praise for strong vocal performances and accessible English translations, though the material itself proves more intellectually intriguing than emotionally engaging for most critics.
